articles.title: Meet the 26 Superstars Kicking Off America's World Cup Dreams!
articles.summary: The U.S. World Cup team is finally here! 26 players, including Christian Pulisic and a striker who scored 19 goals this season, are ready to face Paraguay in Los Angeles. Get to know the squad.

articles.title: Could Peace Between the U.S. and Iran Happen This Weekend?
articles.summary: A deal to stop fighting between the U.S. and Iran might be super close! Pakistan's leader says a final peace text is ready, and Iran agrees it's closer than ever. Even former President Trump says it could be signed soon.

articles.title: A Super-Secret Spy Tool Is About to Expire—What Happens Now?
articles.summary: A powerful U.S. spy program called Section 702 is set to expire on Friday. It lets the government collect messages from people in other countries. Congress couldn't agree on new rules, but experts say spying won't stop right away.
